technology_name: Trichoderma Mass Production Technology Using Areca Leaf Sheath
problem_solved: Cost-effective mass production of Trichoderma harzianum
description: Trichoderma multiplication using areca leaf sheath is a very simple, cost-effective technology for rapid mass production of Trichoderma harzianum (CPTD 28). Trichoderma enriched areca leaf sheath can be effectively utilized for eco-friendly management of stem bleeding and basal stem rot diseases of coconut and also for quick wilt disease of black pepper
applications:
Biopesticide and agricultural bio-input manufacturers
Coconut, cocoa, and plantation crop cultivation enterprises
Organic farming and sustainable agriculture initiatives
Nursery, greenhouse, and potted plant production units
Agricultural extension agencies and farmer producer organizations (FPOs)
